 Nice vs. Paris Saint Germain - Head-to-head record
 The history between Nice and Paris Saint Germain reveals a clear dominance by the latter. In 33 competitive matches, Paris Saint Germain have secured 21 wins , with Nice managing only 5 victories and 7 draws. This long-term record highlights the challenge for the home team.
 Recent encounters reinforce this trend. Paris Saint Germain won six of the last ten meetings, while Nice claimed three victories and one draw. The most recent Nice vs. Paris Saint Germain clash in March 2026 saw PSG triumph 4-0 at the Allianz Riviera.
 Nice’s home advantage against Paris Saint Germain has proven minimal. Out of 16 home games, Nice have won only three, drawn two, and suffered 11 defeats. This historical data boosts Paris Saint Germain’s confidence for the upcoming fixture.

 Nice - In impressive winning form
 Here is a detailed look at Nice’s current situation. We will analyse the team’s momentum and their recent results. This will give you a complete overview before their important game against Paris Saint Germain.
 Recent form
 Nice enters this game with strong momentum, having won their last three Ligue 1 matches. This impressive run, with four victories in their past five league outings, has moved them to 6th in the table. They also remain unbeaten at the Allianz Riviera this season, holding three wins and two draws.
 The team’s attack is potent, led by striker Elye Wahi, who has found the back of the net 6 times in nine appearances. Creative midfielder J. Clauss also contributes with three goals and an assist. This attacking prowess makes Nice a constant threat, vital for breaching the league leaders’ defence.
 Nice boasts a fully fit squad, with no reported injuries for this vital game. This stability, coupled with their formidable home record of 10 goals scored, gives them a strong base. They will feel confident challenging the visitors in the upcoming Nice vs. Paris Saint Germain match.

 Paris Saint Germain - On an incredible winning streak
 Let’s take a look at Paris Saint Germain’s situation. We will analyse the team’s incredible form, recent results, and standout performers for the upcoming match.
 Recent form
 Paris Saint Germain are in unstoppable form, riding an eleven-match winning streak across all competitions. This incredible run includes dominant victories in both Ligue 1 and the UEFA Champions League. Currently sitting top of the league table, their performances on the road have been particularly impressive, where they remain unbeaten this season with four wins and two draws.
 The Parisian attack is firing on all cylinders, with multiple players contributing to their success. Spanish forward Ferran Torres has been a standout performer, finding the back of the net four times. Adding to their threat, defender Achraf Hakimi has also been a major force, scoring three goals and providing two assists from the backline.
 A significant advantage for the visitors is their clean bill of health, as they have no reported injuries ahead of this clash. This allows them to field their strongest possible lineup. With their formidable momentum, a potent attack, and a full-strength squad, PSG arrive at the Allianz Riviera as clear favourites to continue their dominant run.

 While Nice have shown strength at home, PSG’s recent dominant victories, including several high-scoring wins, make a comfortable victory for the visitors likely. A bet on “Paris Saint Germain -1.5” in the Asian Handicap market is an interesting option.
 Considering PSG’s unstoppable momentum and historical dominance in this fixture, our main prediction is a victory for the visitors . We are backing Paris Saint Germain to cover the “-0.5” handicap and secure another win.
